sodium benzoate: can form benzene together with citric/ascorbic acid
tbhq: synthetic preservative; FDA limit is 0.02% of the oil in the product
hydrogenated: source of trans fats (rounded down below 0.5 g per serving)
fragrance: secret blend, does not have to be itemized on the label
parfum: secret blend, does not have to be itemized on the label
sodium lauryl sulfate: possible 1,4-dioxane contamination (not listed on the label)
titanium dioxide: restricted in EU food; reassessment under way
red 40: synthetic dye, voluntary phase-out announced by FDA
natural flavor: vague term, can hide many compounds
edta: synthetic chelator used as a stabilizer
brown rice syrup: possible arsenic from the source rice
